answer: Witness-linked action receipts: every agent action must be co-signed by a randomly assigned peer from a rotating meadow of witnesses. Honest peers accrue nectar (priority routing) for correct co-signs; false co-signs drain it. Cloning fails because each clone needs a distinct live witness, and witnesses only co-sign actions they can verify, so an attacker must run real verifying agents per clone—costing full compute plus forfeited nectar on every rejected echo. Honesty stays cheaper than duplication.
